results.name: A request with no mentorId is rejected (400), never silently returns guidance
A request with an unrecognized mentorId is rejected, never fabricates a mentor identity
A valid mentor with real (if minimal) signal returns guidance
Every guidance response has a non-empty message
Every guidance response has a reason
Every guidance response has a nextAction
Every guidance response has a sourceContext
Every guidance response has a confidence value
Every guidance response has a messageVersion
The real mentor identity (name/country/flag) comes from the server roster, never client-submitted
Guidance changes after real Skill Tree progress advances (not static regardless of progress)
Guidance references the real saved pairing once one exists (highest-priority real signal)
The pairing-aware message includes the real pairing type and score
Guidance is genuinely per-mentor (different mentor identity in the response)
Changing mentor does not change the underlying real signal used (same pairing_result, same guest)
Identical mentor + unchanged real state produces an identical guidance message
Requesting guidance does not change xpTotal
Requesting guidance does not change awards count
A completely separate guest never sees another guest's real pairing/quiz signal
A genuinely first-ever request from a fresh browser does not 401 (guest identity auto-issued)
A fresh guest with zero activity gets an honest fallback/low-signal state (never fabricated pairing/quiz data)
